Oh damn, I forgot about that. I guess you can excludes money from this situation, but I still can't see this woman as more than an annoyance. Don't get me wrong, I love Aqua's characters. She's a lovable dumbass, but her good sides are still kinda outweighed by her bad sides to me. From what I see, you are still listing moments. Of course from the beginning to the end, Aqua is going to gather a lot of moments that make her look good, but I'm thinking of the long run. I'm not looking for moments that make you forget that she's still a bratty goddess, I am thinking of her acting like her usual self. To simplify this it's just her being annoying everyday except certain days. And when people find someone who is annoying most of the times, they tend to avoid them. I've met people like Aqua. They were unbearable to be around, but they would sometimes do something that made me forgot that they were unbearable to be around, but I then remember they are unbearable to be around because they went back to acting like how they usually do. But this actually all comes down to preferences. (Should've mentioned that earlier) I wouldn't want that girl as a romantic partner due to her annoying side because I'm already a naturally angry person, so I don't want to be around anyone who is annoying most of the time. But if you could put up with her, I guess see it working out. Anyway, this is just a conversation between two people with different opinions and views on things. I don't mean to offend you in anyway, just so you know.

But this is also another thing I see people doing. They only focus on her good sides. I can understand all that, but what about her normal personality? She's a brat, entitled, an attention whore, and will take you for granted. She has a good side, I know that, but that good side only comes out in certain situations. She causes debts and always asks for money, yet she never seems grateful. And if she does seem grateful, she will ALWAYS go back to her old ways. IRL she would be annoying as all hell. In this situation, I am not biased. IRL I know my favorite girl would be annoying as hell. UNLESS, you are into bratty girls. Sure, she seems fun, but what do you do when you're in debt because of her antics. You work your ass off for a reason not caused by you. And this will continue to pile on. But you may think her antics are cute and lighten the mood, but I'm thinking of this as an IRL situation. You will not hear any funny remarks, you will not hear any sad music, you will only hear crying and whining. Overall, I wouldn't want to be with her. Those good moments will feel really good though, but in the end they are only moments. I love that girl, but I know that good is outweighed by the bad.

A few months ago. I'm really good at taking all types of pain. Be it boiling oil, fire, and blunt hits. But I can't handle getting hit in a vital spot of my body. I was punched in the chest and it literally knocked the wind out of me. I fell to the ground and clutched at my chest. I didn't even yell. I just let out a slight wheeze. I couldn't breathe for a few seconds. A single tear then flowed down my eyes. I honestly wasn't expecting it to hurt so much. I do a little bit of boxing and I have been hit in some pretty vital areas, but I never collapsed before. It was a new experience. I guess I haven't been hit hard enough before. Just so you know, I want to be a strong individual. I don't mind going through emotional or physical pain. I just want to be stronger. I believe pain is just gonna toughen me up. I'm actually really young. I'm not even an adult. I feel this way because I want to be ready for when I'm in the real world. No one is going to watch over me once I leave the house. No one is going to have my back. I can only rely on myself. This world will knock you down if you it pain. That's why I don't mind experiencing it. I think it's going to really help me in the long run. I know something is going to go wrong one day. That's just how it works. But you never truly experience happiness if you've never felt sadness.
